home.heroTagline: Waste is a resource. Segregate it, reuse it, give it a second life.
home.heroSubtext: Work with Butibori Nagar Parishad to turn household waste into valuable community resources. Wet waste becomes fertile compost; clean dry items find new homes.
home.benefitsSubtext: Simple segregation creates direct social and economic value for our families.
home.benefit1Desc: Reusable clothes, utensils, study books, and appliances are passed on to lower-income families for free or at very low prices.
home.benefit2Desc: Creates local employment in sorting, safe handling, carpentry, tailoring, and electrical repairs right here in Butibori.
home.benefit3Desc: Stops open burning of plastic and rubber, protecting our children's lungs and keeping agricultural soil free from toxic plastics.
home.wetDryNoticeDesc: Wet kitchen waste (vegetable peels, leftover food, garden leaves) is not accepted at donation counters. It is processed separately into agricultural compost.

segregate.pageSubtitle: Two-bin system: Keep wet waste and dry waste strictly separate from the source.
segregate.goldenRuleDesc: Segregation must happen in the home or shop, NOT at the garbage heap. Once dry recyclables touch wet kitchen food, they become dirty and cannot be reused or recycled.
segregate.wetWasteDesc: Biodegradable organic matter from kitchens and farms. Processed into organic compost.
segregate.wetWasteExamples: Fruit & vegetable peels, leftover cooked food, tea leaves, eggshells, garden leaves, flowers, coconut shells.
segregate.dryWasteDesc: Inorganic, clean, and dry materials that can be recycled into raw materials or reused by another family.
segregate.hazardousAlert: NEVER throw hazardous items into normal bins or burn them! Hand them over separately to municipal workers in a designated pouch.
segregate.hazardousItems: Batteries, CFL bulbs, tube lights, expired medicines, pesticide bottles, paint cans, mosquito coils, broken thermometers.
segregate.categoryCardsSummary: Paper, plastic, metal, glass, textiles, e-waste, and household articles.
segregate.itemPaperDesc: Old newspapers, notebooks, cardboard boxes, bills. Keep dry and bundled.
segregate.itemPlasticDesc: Plastic bottles, buckets, oil cans, containers, milk bags. Rinse with a little water and dry.
segregate.itemMetalDesc: Steel dishes, aluminium pots, iron scrap, wire pieces, tin cans. Highly recyclable.
segregate.itemGlassDesc: Intact bottles, cosmetic glass jars. Wrap carefully to protect sanitary workers.
segregate.itemClothDesc: Clean shirts, sarees, bedsheets, blankets, bags. Usable clothes are donated; torn cloth is recycled.
segregate.itemEwasteDesc: Old mobile phones, chargers, headphones, radios, remotes. Contains valuable metals.
segregate.itemHouseholdDesc: School bags, study tables, plastic chairs, toys, bicycles, kitchenware.

impact.pageSubtitle: Every kilogram of waste kept out of landfills creates local wealth and protects Butibori's soil.
impact.comparisonSubtitle: Compare traditional waste dumping with the RRR community circular model.
impact.dumpingSoil: Ash and toxins poison agricultural topsoil, making fields less fertile.
impact.dumpingAir: Emits thick black smoke, dioxins, and particulate matter that trigger asthma in children.
impact.dumpingWater: Chemicals run off into local streams and nullahs during rains.
impact.landfillSoil: Plastic never decomposes, permanently clogging the earth for hundreds of years.
impact.landfillAir: Rotting wet food trapped under plastic produces explosive methane greenhouse gas.
impact.landfillWater: Generates dark liquid 'leachate' that seeps deep into borewells and groundwater.
impact.recyclingSoil: Saves virgin raw materials, keeping mining and industrial waste away from our land.
impact.recyclingAir: Reduces industrial manufacturing emissions by up to 70%.
impact.recyclingWater: Significantly cuts down water pollution from plastic manufacturing.
impact.reuseSoil: Zero new extraction required; products live a second life.
impact.reuseAir: No industrial chimney emissions; extends item usefulness by years.
impact.reuseWater: Eliminates washing and industrial processing demands.
impact.compostSoil: Enriches soil with natural humus, reviving farmland fertility naturally.
impact.compostAir: Aerobic decomposition produces clean organic compost instead of methane.
impact.compostWater: Retains soil moisture, decreasing irrigation water requirements.

impact.jobsSubtitle: Waste management isn't just about cleaning—it is a dependable source of local livelihoods for Butibori residents.
impact.jobsPriorityNotice: All job positions prioritize residents of Butibori and neighboring villages with fair wages and safe working gear.
impact.job1Desc: Inspect and categorize incoming dry materials into paper, metal, and graded plastics with safety gear.
impact.job2Desc: Assist at Saturday collection counters and manage loading for transport vehicles.
impact.job3Desc: Local carpenters, tailors, and electricians who repair desks, clothes, and appliances for reuse.
impact.job4Desc: Catalog items, manage customer enquiries, and arrange distributions for deserving families.
impact.job5Desc: Visit residential wards, schools, and self-help groups (Bachat Gat) to explain proper segregation.
impact.job6Desc: Coordinate logistics, report weekly metrics to the Nagar Parishad, and resolve citizen issues.
